programme.title: Donning
programme.desc: A month into their studies, the trio struggles to balance an overwhelming syllabus, challenging practicals, and the desire to enjoy college life. An unexpected revelation about Nishant changes the group's dynamics.

programme.title: Patient Zero
programme.desc: Midterm results bring surprises, prompting celebrations that uncover deeper issues the friends must confront together.

programme.title: Lockdown
programme.desc: Huma faces a crisis of confidence, seeking unconventional advice to regain her footing. A heartbreaking event forces the friends to reevaluate their priorities and the strength of their bond.

programme.title: Critical Condition
programme.desc: As final exams approach, Huma contemplates unethical shortcuts, leading to revelations that challenge perceptions and test the integrity of their friendship.

programme.title: Fomo
programme.desc: Dhruv and Kavya plan a lazy Sunday but feel the pressure of missing out when they see their friends enjoying exciting activities on social media. This leads them to seek ways to spice up their day.

programme.title: Have A Nice Day
programme.desc: A morning rush to work results in a tussle between Dhruv and Kavya, spoiling their moods. Throughout the day, they attempt to make amends, highlighting the irony and sweetness of their relationship.

programme.title: Good Night
programme.desc: A sleepless night due to mosquitoes leads to the discovery that Kavya's ex-boyfriend is getting married, prompting a long conversation about their past relationships.

programme.title: Thank You!
programme.desc: Plans for a dinner at an Iranian restaurant get canceled, leading Dhruv and Kavya to attend a friend's house party. The night evolves into an unexpected adventure, ending at a local fair.

programme.title: Here We Go!
programme.desc: During a visit to a vineyard, Dhruv and Kavya open up about their insecurities and future aspirations, leading to deeper conversations about life and their relationship.

programme.title: Masterji
programme.desc: Kishore, an orphan has only one dream, to join the IndianArmy. When he gets thrown out of his orphanage, Masterji, an ex-army officer who left the army and is now working as a tailor, reluctantly adopts him. The khadoos Masterji and Kishore have only two things in common, their dream to serve the nation and their lonely lives. Will Masterji help Kishore achieve his own unfulfilled dreams to become a soldier, and will Kishore find a father in Masterji?

programme.title: Jaldi Lautna, Captain
programme.desc: Captain Vikrant Sahay and his wife Vibha had a beautiful love story. But Vikrant’s sudden death in battle leaves the otherwise happy-go-lucky Vibha completely shocked. Unable to deal with Vikrant’s death, Vibha decides that the best way to honor him is to fulfill his dream, by joining the army herself, much against her family’s wishes. Will Vibha succeed and make her late husband, her family, and the country proud?

programme.title: Shooter Jawan
programme.desc: Tribhuvan, a dedicated Indian Army Officer comes across a young sweeper Tinku, who is a gifted shooter. Tribhuvan knows Tinku has a rare talent, and wants to enroll him in the shooting academy and then the Indian Army. However, owing to Tinku’s caste, his father is afraid of society’s taunts and is completely against this career choice. Will Tinku have the courage to fight back and rise above ‘log kya kahenge’?

programme.title: Sarhad Ke Baad Bhi
programme.desc: Colonel Balram, a retired Indian Army Officer, returns home after several years of service, only to find himself completely disconnected from his son Aman. While Balram is failing at mending his relationship with Aman, he is also silently struggling with mental health issues, because of his days at war. Will Aman ever understand his father’s sacrifices for the country or will it be too late before he realises just how much his father loves him?

programme.title: Veera
programme.desc: Veera’s martyred father’s last wish was for her to join the Indian armed forces. But Veera is not for it. The bravery and patriotism that the country remembers and celebrates him for, are the same things that took Veera’s father away from her. She’s been carrying this anger and hurt in her heart for too long, until she discovers a hidden letter.

programme.title: Bachelorhood
programme.desc: Viraj and Arjun have been best friends since childhood. While Viraj loves his bachelor life and wants Arjun to move in as his flatmate, Arjun has other plans of ‘settling down’. What happens when this bachelor reveals he wants to be ‘unbachelored?’

programme.title: Kabab Mein Haddi
programme.desc: The gang gets together to celebrate Arjun’s big news, but Viraj is concerned whether the dynamics of the group will change with its new addition. Will Khushi win over the gang and get Viraj's stamp of approval?

programme.title: (un)happy Birthday
programme.desc: Its Arjun’s birthday, and Khushi steals the limelight with her unconventional celebration party. Tensions at the party rise when Viraj confronts Arjun about his change in behaviour since he started dating Khushi. Will Arjun pick pyaar or dosti?

programme.title: Mann Ki Rant
programme.desc: The group tries to resolve tensions between Viraj and Arjun, but they both resist. As Viraj rants to Zara and Kaka about his friendships and relationships, he realises more about his true self.

programme.title: Yaar Ki Shaadi
programme.desc: The wedding day is here! Will Viraj stand by Arjun on the most important day of his life, and will he admit his true feelings to a special someone?

programme.title: Conflict Of Interest
programme.desc: Shagun wants to keep the Filmy Weddings business floating and for that she’s willing to go to any lengths. Even if it means shooting a wedding film for Adhira’s ex-boyfriend – Akhil. Adhira is furious and tries her best to sabotage the entire project. Unfortunately, her one big hurdle is Dad, who has taken quite a fondness for Akhil. Check out the episode and find out what happens next!

programme.title: Internal Politics
programme.desc: Adhira and Shagun are in a disagreement about whom to select for a wedding film promo: a boring aunt from the bride's side or a lively drunk aunt from the groom's family. Things take a turn for the complicated when the parents also weigh in with their respective biases.

programme.title: Poaching The Talent
programme.desc: Vishnu, the Agarwal's househelp cum man friday is desired by the sisters as an office boy to help them sort out their business affairs. The parents are naturally opposed to the idea. Thus begins another standoff in the Agarwal household - and Vishnu's position in the house is at stake. Who will finally lay claim over Vishnu's priceless services?

programme.title: Business Secrets
programme.desc: In a footage from a wedding they just filmed, the sisters find a drunken confession from the bride's best friend. It turns out she is the groom's ex - and he hasn't told the bride to be. Caught in the moral dilemma of choosing to tell the bride or not, the sisters find themselves on other ends of the argument. Meanwhile, it is revealed that Adhira's father might have a similar secret hidden from everyone. Will the sisters do the morally right thing or the financially right thing? And what is the father's bizarre obsession with knowing who the groom's mom is?

programme.title: Breach Of Contract
programme.desc: Chasing a competitive business pitch to work for a coveted fashion firm, the sisters are again at different sides of a dilemma. The commitment to the new opportunity would be for a minimum two years, which Adhira is reluctant to make at the age of 25. Whereas Shagun, having already quit her high paying corporate job to join this business, sees no harm in seizing the opportunity with open arms. As their argument turns to a fight, we are left wondering if this is in fact the fight to end all fights. Will the sisters come to the same page and work for the pitch? Or will Happily Hitched disband for good?

programme.title: Arranged Family
programme.desc: Nikhil Solanki arrives at his in-laws' home, where a series of mishaps culminate in a significant blunder that upsets his father-in-law, Prakash Sharma. Both struggle to address the situation openly.

programme.title: The Mad House
programme.desc: Prakash avoids acknowledging that Nikhil damaged his car, instead blaming neighborhood children. Nikhil's attempts to rectify the situation lead to further complications.

programme.title: Conditions Apply
programme.desc: During Sudha and Prakash's anniversary celebration, relatives pose uncomfortable questions, challenging Nikhil's patience and composure.

programme.title: Stuck In The Middle
programme.desc: A disagreement between Anita and her parents results in a cold war, leaving Nikhil caught between his wife and in-laws.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: Nikhil expresses his feelings of being an outsider within the family, prompting an open discussion aimed at resolving underlying issues.

programme.title: Welcome Home
programme.desc: A few months after moving to Mumbai, Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) and Anita are finally settled. The peace is interrupted by the arrival of Nikhil's parents, Kiran (Shishir Sharma) and Vandana (Renuka Shahane), for a short visit. Anita, ever the perfectionist, is anxious to be the "perfect daughter-in-law," but her efforts are met with a series of awkward and hilarious hurdles.

programme.title: Surprise, Surprise!
programme.desc: The episode picks up with the fallout of Nikhil’s father, Kiran (Shishir Sharma), going missing during his walk in the previous episode. While he eventually returns, the tension doesn't dissipate. The "surprise" of the title is twofold: the unexpected arrival of Nikhil’s sister, Shreya (Kriti Vij), and the unsettling realization that something is physically or mentally "off" with Kiran.

programme.title: Spilling The Beans
programme.desc: The entire family—Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh), Anita (Eisha Chopra), Kiran (Shishir Sharma), Vandana (Renuka Shahane), and Shreya (Kriti Vij)—piles into a car to attend a relative's 60th birthday celebration. What was meant to be a joyful getaway becomes a pressure cooker for the long-standing resentment between the siblings.

programme.title: Something's Missing
programme.desc: The title is a poignant double entendre: it refers to a missing set of rings at the family function, but more deeply, it refers to the "missing" pieces of Kiran’s (Shishir Sharma) memory. The facade of a "normal family vacation" finally crumbles, forcing the Solankis to stop pretending.

programme.title: House Of Cards
programme.desc: The title "House of Cards" refers to the fragile "perfect family" image the Solankis have tried to maintain. After the emotional explosion regarding Kiran’s (Shishir Sharma) health and Shreya’s (Kriti Vij) marriage, the "house" has finally collapsed—but in its place, something more honest is being built.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: In the Season 2 finale, "Home," Anita and Nikhil prepare to move into their own place. The episode resolves the season's friction between Anita and her mother-in-law, replacing awkward formalities with genuine mutual respect. As they move out, the story concludes that "home" isn't about physical space, but the emotional bridge built between two different generations.

programme.title: Circle Of Life
programme.desc: The title "Circle of Life" refers to the poignant role reversal where the children now become the guardians of their parents, mirroring the care they once received.

programme.title: Not Kidding
programme.desc: The episode centers on a visit from Anita’s boisterous, unfiltered parents—Akshata (Deepika Amin) and Kiran Sharma (Shishir Sharma). The quiet, disciplined, and currently somber Solanki household is suddenly upended by the high-energy Sharmas. The primary conflict arises when the two sets of parents have a "polite clash" over how to care for the ailing Kiran Solanki and, more pivotally, the couple's future plans regarding children.

programme.title: Here We Go Again
programme.desc: With the house now fully "merged," Anita (Eisha Chopra) and Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) decide to throw a surprise anniversary party for the "Folks." While their intentions are pure, the episode explores how a "celebration" can quickly become a source of stress when dealing with a chronic illness and interfering relatives.

programme.title: Zor Se Bolo
programme.desc: The episode revolves around a chaotic Sunday at the Solanki household. The central plot involves Kiran Solanki (Shishir Sharma) needing a hearing aid, but it quickly spirals into a larger commentary on how the family members are "deaf" to each other's actual needs and desires.

programme.title: That's All Folks
programme.desc: The finale moves away from the day-to-day bickering and centers on a quiet realization: Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) and Anita (Eisha Chopra) have finally stopped "adjusting" and have started living. The episode focuses on the family accepting their "New Normal" while acknowledging that the road ahead with Kiran’s (Shishir Sharma) health will be challenging but shared.

programme.title: Truth Bombs
programme.desc: The episode begins with Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) and Anita (Esha Chopra) gathering the family for a "serious talk." After months of private deliberation, they drop the ultimate truth bomb: they have decided to adopt a child instead of pursuing a biological pregnancy.

programme.title: The Damaad Test
programme.desc: The episode centers on the Home Study, a critical step in the Indian adoption process where a government social worker visits the family to determine if they are fit to raise a child. However, the title "The Damaad Test" (The Son-in-law Test) refers to the parallel pressure Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) feels to prove he is a "good son" while also being a "good son-in-law" to Anita’s (Eisha Chopra) visiting parents.

programme.title: Vote For Minnie
programme.desc: Minnie runs for president of the Adventure Club. But Pete is also running! Who will win and be elected the next president?

programme.title: Mickey And The Kitten-Sitters
programme.desc: Enjoy quick, charming Disney and Pixar bedtime stories! Join Anna, Elsa, Mickey, Minnie, and Scamp in exciting adventures. These five-minute tales are perfect for ending the day.

programme.title: Minnie Saves Christmas
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Christmas stories, little ones are sure to be carried off to sleep full of holiday cheer.

programme.title: The Haunted Halloween
programme.desc: With this collection of spooky Halloween stories, little ones will be tricked and treated off to sleep with some of their favorite Disney and Pixar characters.

programme.title: Minnie's Surprise
programme.desc: Minnie and Daisy are hired to babysit Clara Cluck's egg, but it begins to hatch on their watch! Follow as the Happy Helpers try to get the mama hen and her egg back together in time.

programme.title: Race For The Rigatoni Ribbon
programme.desc: Mickey and the gang head to Italy to compete in the Race for the Rigatoni Ribbon. Do the Roadster Racers have a chance at winning the race? Follow along with word-for-word narration to find out!

programme.title: A Hot-Dog Day
programme.desc: When Minnie plans a picnic for Daisy and friends, they all pitch in with the help of a misplaced basket.

programme.title: Minnie-rella
programme.desc: The fairy tale is based on the story of Cindrella. Minnie Mouse falls asleep while doing chores and dreams that she becomes Minnierella! She needs help to get ready for Prince Mickey's Grand Ball.

programme.title: Colors All Around
programme.desc: Join Mickey, Minnie, and the rest of the gane as they search for their favorite colors. Follow along with word-for-word narration and help them find all the colors in the rainbow!

programme.title: Mickey Saves Santa
programme.desc: Mickey and his friends are all ready for a Christmas Eve sleepover at the Clubhouse. They've written their lists and can't wait for Santa Claus to arrive. Santa won't be coming unless he gets some help!

programme.title: Mickey's Easter Hunt
programme.desc: The Clubhouse pals are throwing an Easter party and Pete's upset because he thinks he isn't invited. Pete decides to make a change in the Clubhouse, he makes it disappear-with the friends still inside!

programme.title: Mickey's Halloween Treat
programme.desc: Mickey and his friends want to go to the Tower, for the Halloween party but, they have to get there before the moon is full! Toodles and Mouseketools are what Mickey need to find on his way to the tower.

programme.title: Minnie's Rainbow
programme.desc: In this colorful tale, Minnie Mouse simply explains how these beautiful apparitions are formed. Follow the narration as Minnie and her Clubhouse pals begin to see a world of rainbows around them.

programme.title: Top O' The Clubhouse
programme.desc: It's Saint Patrick's Day. Mickey and the gang are ready to celebrate! But when Pete's shenanigans threaten to ruin their celebration, it will take some help from Toodles, to get the party back on track.

programme.title: Homesick
programme.desc: Being sick is no fun for anyone, but Funny's sneezes are extra funny! Every sneeze sends Mickey, Minnie, and the rest of the gang through the wrong Adventure Doors. Will Funny ever feel better?

programme.title: Donald'S Stinky Day
programme.desc: When Donald accidentally rescues a cute little skunk, the grateful little stinker refuses to leave his side!

programme.title: Mickey'S Perfecto Day
programme.desc: Mickey and the Roadster Racers head to Madrid, Spain for some racing and sightseeing fun. But when a baby bull begins to chase them around town, their perfecto vacation starts to crumble!

programme.title: Ski Trippin
programme.desc: The gang is teaching Daisy to ski when she accidentally ends up in the middle of aa big skiing race! Using the skills she's learned along the way, can she pull off a big win?

programme.title: Hocus Bow-Cus
programme.desc: Minnie is launching her new 'Bows are Magical' fashion line. He forgot his bow tie at home, he rushes off to find it. Millie and Melody rehearsed with Penguini, but will they remember all the tricks?

programme.title: Minnie's Pet Salon
programme.desc: Minnie and friends get ready to pamper their pets at Minnie's Pet Salon! It's a spa day like no other for Pluto, Figaro, Bella, Butch, and Mr. Pettibone!

programme.title: The Case Of The Missing Sparkle-izer
programme.desc: Who's been using Minnie's new Sparkle-izer? When Minnie needs it to decorate her customers' bows, the Super Sparkle-izer turns up missing! It's up to Millie and Melody to solve the mystifying mystery!

programme.title: Always In Fashion
programme.desc: Minnie Mouse is always in fashion! She and Daisy love making bows at Minnie's Bow-tique. All of their friends want Minnie to make them bows.

programme.title: Blooming Bows
programme.desc: Minnie's nieces are very upset! The paper petals on their costumes are falling apart. Now, it''s up to Minnie to redesign the girls' costumes. But can she do it in time for the school's Posy Pageant?

programme.title: Bow-Bot Robot
programme.desc: Minnie and Daisy get some help from a bow-making robot in this retelling of an episode of Disney Junior's Minnie's Bow Toons.

programme.title: Easter Bonnet Parade
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! One day, a little puppy with nowhere to go arrived at the Main Street USA train station. Seeking for a place to call his own, follow along as the little pup explores the town.

programme.title: Trouble Times Two
programme.desc: Movie star Penelope Poodle has come to Minnie''s Bow-Tique to find something perfect to wear. But when Minnie''s mischievous twin nieces, Millie and Melody, come for a visit, it''s Trouble Times Two!

programme.title: Year Round Fun
programme.desc: Book with magnet set in a case

programme.title: Riches To Rags
programme.desc: A young boy is taken to work by his Papa and Grandpa in an old wooden boat. He discovers his family's unusual line of work and will decide whether to follow them or find his way.

programme.title: Blue-Ribbon Bunny
programme.desc: Sofia and her bunny Clover enter a pet contest. Other kids have fancy pets. Sofia must decide: enter with a fancy pet or stay loyal to her best friend, Clover.

programme.title: Clover Time
programme.desc: When Clover's warren floods, Sofia invites her to move in. They love sharing a room-at first. But Sofia soon learns that being roommates isn't always easy in this fun story!

programme.title: Just One Of The Princes
programme.desc: Sofia wants to try out for a spot on Royal Prep's Flying Derby team, but Amber, Prince Hugo, and her classmates tell Sofia that Flying Derby is not a 'princess thing.'

programme.title: The Missing Necklace
programme.desc: When the Amulet of Avalor goes missing, Sofia loses her ability to understand her friends. Longing to talk to her friends again, Sofia sets off to find it. Cedric is also after the missing amulet.

programme.title: Welcome To Royal Prep
programme.desc: At Royal Prep's Open House, Amber's special painting gets ruined by James! Can Sofia help her fix it before her parents arrive? Find out in this exciting story!

programme.title: Me And Our Mom
programme.desc: Sofia is so excited to spend the day with her mom at the annual Mother's Day Picnic -until she learns that Amber and James are joining too. Sofia wants her mom to herself on Mother's Day!

programme.title: The Curse Of Princess Ivy
programme.desc: In this beautifully illustrated eBook, Sofia faces grave danger when she faces Princess Ivy, a once-exiled princess who is determined to take over Enchancia and turn the whole kingdom black and white.

programme.title: A Royal Mouse In The House
programme.desc: It's the Enchancia Pet Show! Hildegard's mink, Lulu, runs away, and Hildegard turns into a mouse! Sofia and Clover must solve the mystery and reverse the spell before the show begins.

programme.title: Princess Sofia'S Busy Day
programme.desc: Today is another busy day in the kingdom of Enchancia for Princess Sofia. Join Sofia and see what an ordinary day is like for this new princess!

programme.title: Royal Fun
programme.desc: Life in Enchancia is full of fun! Join Sofia as she explores all the fun things there are to do-from dancing to joining the flying derby team and even spending the day at the Village Faire.

programme.title: Sofia The First
programme.desc: Sofia was a little girl who lived a rather ordinary life. But everything changed when her mother married the king.

programme.title: The Amulet And The Anthem
programme.desc: Sofia is chosen to sing the Enchancian Anthem at the annual Harvest Festival. After she becomes a bit too boastful, Sofia's magical amulet bestows a curse on her, leaving her all croaked up!

programme.title: The Enchanted Science Fair
programme.desc: When Sofia and her friends discover that they need to find a magical ingredient at the top of a mountain, they compete to see who can reach the summit first! Can Sofia convince her fellow students.

programme.title: A Time for Courage
programme.desc: Follow Mulan's courageous journey as she disguises herself to take her father's place in the Imperial Army, defending China against the Huns in this inspiring story.

programme.title: Honor For Father
programme.desc: Enjoy quick stories with Disney and Pixar girls! Join Moana, Helen Parr, and others on fun adventures. Perfect for bedtime reading in just five minutes!

programme.title: Khan To The Rescue
programme.desc: Mulan's grandmother is missing! Khan the horse alerts Mulan, who sees Grandma's hat and basket. Together, Mulan and Khan bravely search for and rescue her.

programme.title: Aurora's Homemade Holiday
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! With this sweet collection of Disney Christmas stories, little ones are sure to be carried off to sleep full of holiday cheer.

programme.title: Listen To Your Heart
programme.desc: Pocahontas faces a tough choice. English settlers arrive, threatening her land and people. She must choose between her heart and protecting her village, seeking a path to peace.

programme.title: Raya'S Team
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Meet Raya, a lone warrior from the fantasy kingdom of Kumandra, and her mighty team.

programme.title: The Fight For Kumandra
programme.desc: It's up to Raya to find the last dragon and save the world of Kumandra!

programme.title: Raya And The Last Dragon
programme.desc: Raya, a warrior, seeks the last dragon to save Kumandra. She unites with a group to restore light and unity to their world in this adventure.

programme.title: Aurora And The Helpful Dragon
programme.desc: When Aurora brings a baby dragon from the forest. The little dragon tries to act like the other castle animals-a cat, a dog, a bird, even a fish-but something goes wrong every time.

programme.title: Anna & Elsa: Olaf'S Perfect Summer Day
programme.desc: Summer is here in Arendelle, and Olaf is very happy! He loves summer days. This story follows Olaf as he enjoys his perfect day in the warm weather.

programme.title: Tiana's Friendship Fix Up
programme.desc: Tiana learns to heal friendships through kindness and trust. Conflicts test her, but love and understanding prove the key to lasting magical bonds.

programme.title: Meet A.R.F
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Bob builds a robotic helper for this pug pups in this Pre-Level 1 reader.

programme.title: Lights, Camera, Perry
programme.desc: Phineas and Ferb enter Perry in a mascot contest, and he becomes famous. But his Agent P fedora is everywhere! Will this fame expose his secret identity? Read to find out!

programme.title: Smitten With A Kitten
programme.desc: After Doc finds a toy kitten, she brings her home to meet the toys. Lambie falls in love with the little kitty and wants to adopt her. But anytime Lambie or the toys come close, the kitten runs away!

programme.title: Sealed With A Kiss
programme.desc: Ariel loves playing hide-and-seek with her little seal friend. But when the princess can't find him anywhere she begins to worry. Ariel searches the ocean to find her friend.

programme.title: Babysitting Mode
programme.desc: Jack-Jack may look like a normal baby, but don't let that cute face fool you! Follow along with narration as his babysitter finds out firsthand that this little guy can do some incredible things.

programme.title: Night Of The Giant Floating Baby Head
programme.desc: Enjoy this two-in-one Halloween-themed book starring Phineas, Ferb, and Perry the Platypus!

programme.title: Babysitter Bunga
programme.desc: Bunga becomes the unorthodox babysitter in the Pride Lands, teaching kids how to defend themselves. Follow the narration as they use his lessons to fight off the jackals!

programme.title: Finding Dory
programme.desc: This is the story of the friendly-but-forgetful blue tang fish as she tries to reunite with her loved ones, and everyone learns a few things about the true meaning of family along the way.

programme.title: Beyond The Palace Walls
programme.desc: Princess Jasmine has dreams that go far beyond the palace walls. When she ventures into the kingdom beyond her home, will she find the adventure she longs for?

programme.title: Puppy Trouble
programme.desc: Nanny takes all fifteen puppies to play in the park. One of the puppies, Lucky, can be quite a troublemaker. Follow along with word-for-word narration as Lucky makes his way of out of mischief.

programme.title: The Puppies' First Christmas
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Christmas stories, little ones are sure to be carried off to sleep full of holiday cheer.

programme.title: Thunderbolt Patch
programme.desc: When Patch the puppy notices a mouse in the house, he pretends to be his TV hero, Thunderbolt the Dog and leads the pups on a wild chase after the bandit. Everyone will love the world of 101 Dalmatians.

programme.title: A Lion's Pride
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Explore the life of a lioness and her cub on the African plains through this photo-filled storybook. Perfect for young fans!

programme.title: A Friend Like Him
programme.desc: Few characters have Aladdin's singing, dancing, and joke-telling Genie's unique, irresistible appeal. This delightful picture book is ideal for any Aladdin fan who imagined having a friend like Genie.

programme.title: A Present For The Queen
programme.desc: Alice searches for a Christmas gift for the Queen of Hearts.

programme.title: The Coziest Carriage
programme.desc: When Scat Cat's home in the junkyard disappears one day, Duchess, O'Malley and their kittens come up with a new place for their pal! See how this family helps their friend when he needs them most.

programme.title: Beauty And The Beast
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Princess stories, little ones will fall asleep dreaming of fairy-tale endings and happily ever afters.

programme.title: Belle And The Castle Puppy
programme.desc: Belle gets a puppy, making Ottoman jealous because he misses being a real dog. He runs into the woods, and Belle and the puppy must rescue him.

programme.title: Belle And The Perfect Pearl
programme.desc: When Belle finds the Beast's favourite book, she sees that the leather cover is worn out. Belle decides to look for the missing pearl and fix up the book for the Beast as a surprise!

programme.title: Belle's Friendship Invention
programme.desc: When Belle sees a crowd gathered around a blue ribbon-winning invention, she volunteers to help the inventor-a girl named Simone-demonstrate how her machine works.

programme.title: Something More
programme.desc: Illustrated throughout with fantastic film stills this book presents an overview of the people, places, and creatures to be found in the magical tale of Beauty and the Beast.

programme.title: I Am Baymax
programme.desc: This is a comedy-adventure about brilliant robotics prodigy Hiro Hamada, who finds himself in the grips of a criminal plot that threatens to destroy the fast-paced, high-tech city of San Fransokyo.

programme.title: Baymax's Journey
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Follow Baymax as he travels through San Fransokyo in this charming storybook featuring word for word narration.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: Hiro, a smart kid, lives in San Fransokyo. A crime threatens the city. With friends and Baymax, a robot, Hiro becomes a hero. They must save their home!

programme.title: Fight To The Finish
programme.desc: Someone stole Hiro's invention and is using it for evil! Hiro must join forces with his friends and a robot named Baymax to save San Fransokyo before it's too late!

programme.title: Cars
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen takes to the track in three tales of speed! Follow along with word-for-word narration in this level one World of Reading reader bind up featuring Cars, Racing Days, etc.

programme.title: Driving Buddies
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, a race car, gets lost and finds friends in a small town. He learns important life lessons. Get ready for an exciting adventure!

programme.title: Driving School
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and Mater must teach hot rod racers the rules of Radiator Springs. This story features characters from Disney/Pixar's Cars, promising a fun-filled adventure for young readers.

programme.title: Racing Days
programme.desc: Doc and Chick Hicks hold 3 races to see whose racing school is best. While Doc's student racers follow the rules, Chick's student racers bend them.

programme.title: Racing For Good
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and Jeff Gorvette love to race, but there is one thing they love more: helping others. In this action-packed storybook, Lightning and his friends race to raise money to help old cars.

programme.title: Rally To The Finish
programme.desc: Lightning and Mater travel to the Black Forest for a race. Lightning is excited to race through the forest, but Mater gets scared when an old car tells them that a monster lives there.

programme.title: Roadwork
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, a race car, wants to win the Piston Cup. He ends up in Radiator Springs. McQueen learns that friendship is important.

programme.title: Francesco's Rematch
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and his racing rival Francesco Bernoulli challenge each other to a race in Monza, Italy-Francesco's hometown. Both Lightning and Francesco are confident they will win the race.

programme.title: Mater And The Ghost Light
programme.desc: Mater the tow truck loves pranking his friends. But after he hears a scary story, Mater loses all zest for pranking. Now, he just wants to hide!

programme.title: Mater The Greater
programme.desc: Mater the Greater is a brave stunt performer who does many dangerous things in front of crowds. He jumps cars, flies through fire, and rides planes. Now, can he do his biggest stunt?

programme.title: Mater's Junkyard Jamboree
programme.desc: Mater can't wait to show his friends in Radiator Springs the junkyard jukebox he built, but they are too busy rounding up tractors on the loose-and the tractors are causing trouble everywhere they go!

programme.title: Monster Truck Mater

programme.title: Boo To You, Winnie The Pooh

programme.title: Not a Creature Was Stirring, Except for a Platypus
programme.desc: Twas the night before Christmas not a creature was stirring except for a platypus. When Dr. Doofenshmirtz creates an inator.

programme.title: Roaring Rivals
programme.desc: Mike and Sulley are best friends and partners at Monsters, Inc. But when they met, at Monsters University, the monsters did not like each other at all!

programme.title: A Perfect Picnic
programme.desc: It's springtime, and what better way to celebrate than with a picnic? Come along with Mickey Mouse and friends as they enjoy the beautiful day with great food and even better company.

programme.title: Pied Piper Mickey
programme.desc: Snuggle up and read your favorite classic Mickey tales in this adorable first collection of bedtime stories!

programme.title: Miguel And The Amazing Alebrijes
programme.desc: Goldie and Bear have fun learning to fly with a lost broomstick. But when the owner is found, they must say goodbye. Read this adorable Disney storybook!

programme.title: Anna & Elsa: A New Reindeer Friend
programme.desc: Anna, Elsa, and Olaf rescue a reindeer before a ball. They face a challenge to arrive on time. This story shows friendship and adventure.

programme.title: Beyond The Palace Walls
programme.desc: Princess Jasmine has dreams that go far beyond the palace walls. When she ventures into the kingdom beyond her home, will she find the adventure she longs for?

programme.title: Puppy Trouble
programme.desc: Nanny takes all fifteen puppies to play in the park. One of the puppies, Lucky, can be quite a troublemaker. Follow along with word-for-word narration as Lucky makes his way of out of mischief.

programme.title: The Puppies' First Christmas
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Christmas stories, little ones are sure to be carried off to sleep full of holiday cheer.

programme.title: Thunderbolt Patch
programme.desc: When Patch the puppy notices a mouse in the house, he pretends to be his TV hero, Thunderbolt the Dog and leads the pups on a wild chase after the bandit. Everyone will love the world of 101 Dalmatians.

programme.title: A Lion's Pride
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Explore the life of a lioness and her cub on the African plains through this photo-filled storybook. Perfect for young fans!

programme.title: A Friend Like Him
programme.desc: Few characters have Aladdin's singing, dancing, and joke-telling Genie's unique, irresistible appeal. This delightful picture book is ideal for any Aladdin fan who imagined having a friend like Genie.

programme.title: A Present For The Queen
programme.desc: Alice searches for a Christmas gift for the Queen of Hearts.

programme.title: The Coziest Carriage
programme.desc: When Scat Cat's home in the junkyard disappears one day, Duchess, O'Malley and their kittens come up with a new place for their pal! See how this family helps their friend when he needs them most.

programme.title: Beauty And The Beast
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Princess stories, little ones will fall asleep dreaming of fairy-tale endings and happily ever afters.

programme.title: Belle And The Castle Puppy
programme.desc: Belle gets a puppy, making Ottoman jealous because he misses being a real dog. He runs into the woods, and Belle and the puppy must rescue him.

programme.title: Belle And The Perfect Pearl
programme.desc: When Belle finds the Beast's favourite book, she sees that the leather cover is worn out. Belle decides to look for the missing pearl and fix up the book for the Beast as a surprise!

programme.title: Belle's Friendship Invention
programme.desc: When Belle sees a crowd gathered around a blue ribbon-winning invention, she volunteers to help the inventor-a girl named Simone-demonstrate how her machine works.

programme.title: Something More
programme.desc: Illustrated throughout with fantastic film stills this book presents an overview of the people, places, and creatures to be found in the magical tale of Beauty and the Beast.

programme.title: I Am Baymax
programme.desc: This is a comedy-adventure about brilliant robotics prodigy Hiro Hamada, who finds himself in the grips of a criminal plot that threatens to destroy the fast-paced, high-tech city of San Fransokyo.

programme.title: Baymax's Journey
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Follow Baymax as he travels through San Fransokyo in this charming storybook featuring word for word narration.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: Hiro, a smart kid, lives in San Fransokyo. A crime threatens the city. With friends and Baymax, a robot, Hiro becomes a hero. They must save their home!

programme.title: Fight To The Finish
programme.desc: Someone stole Hiro's invention and is using it for evil! Hiro must join forces with his friends and a robot named Baymax to save San Fransokyo before it's too late!

programme.title: Cars
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen takes to the track in three tales of speed! Follow along with word-for-word narration in this level one World of Reading reader bind up featuring Cars, Racing Days, etc.

programme.title: Driving Buddies
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, a race car, gets lost and finds friends in a small town. He learns important life lessons. Get ready for an exciting adventure!

programme.title: Driving School
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and Mater must teach hot rod racers the rules of Radiator Springs. This story features characters from Disney/Pixar's Cars, promising a fun-filled adventure for young readers.

programme.title: Racing Days
programme.desc: Doc and Chick Hicks hold 3 races to see whose racing school is best. While Doc's student racers follow the rules, Chick's student racers bend them.

programme.title: Racing For Good
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and Jeff Gorvette love to race, but there is one thing they love more: helping others. In this action-packed storybook, Lightning and his friends race to raise money to help old cars.

programme.title: Rally To The Finish
programme.desc: Lightning and Mater travel to the Black Forest for a race. Lightning is excited to race through the forest, but Mater gets scared when an old car tells them that a monster lives there.

programme.title: Roadwork
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, a race car, wants to win the Piston Cup. He ends up in Radiator Springs. McQueen learns that friendship is important.

programme.title: Francesco's Rematch
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and his racing rival Francesco Bernoulli challenge each other to a race in Monza, Italy-Francesco's hometown. Both Lightning and Francesco are confident they will win the race.

programme.title: Mater And The Ghost Light
programme.desc: Mater the tow truck loves pranking his friends. But after he hears a scary story, Mater loses all zest for pranking. Now, he just wants to hide!

programme.title: Mater The Greater
programme.desc: Mater the Greater is a brave stunt performer who does many dangerous things in front of crowds. He jumps cars, flies through fire, and rides planes. Now, can he do his biggest stunt?

programme.title: Mater's Junkyard Jamboree
programme.desc: Mater can't wait to show his friends in Radiator Springs the junkyard jukebox he built, but they are too busy rounding up tractors on the loose-and the tractors are causing trouble everywhere they go!

programme.title: Monster Truck Mater
programme.desc: To become a world-champion monster truck wrestler, Mater must go through the ranks as a professional. I-Screamer, Captain Collision, and The Rasta Carian won't give up easily.

programme.title: Neon Racers
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and his international racing friends are in Japan for the next leg of the T-ROC-the Transcontinental Race of Champions. But this isn't a normal race.it's a neon race!

programme.title: Radiator Springs Road Trip
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen's friends travel to California to support him in a race. They discover a rival is plotting against him and rush to warn him.

programme.title: Rescue Squad Mater
programme.desc: If there is a fire in Radiator Springs, Rescue Squad Mater is on the job! One day his best friend Lightning McQueen gets trapped in a burning building, and itis up to Mater to save him.

programme.title: The Best Present Ever
programme.desc: If there is a fire in Radiator Springs, Rescue Squad Mater is on the job! One day his best friend Lightning McQueen gets trapped in a burning building, and itis up to Mater to save him.

programme.title: Tractor Trouble
programme.desc: Lightning and Mater want to relax by tractor tipping. They accidentally release the tractors! Can they round them up in time? Read along to find out in this fun adventure!

programme.desc: Mater decides to teach it all his favorite things to do on Earth. But when the UFO is kidnapped, Mater must go undercover to rescue his friend.

programme.desc: All the world's a racetrack as superstar Lightning McQueen zooms back into action, with his best friend Mater in tow, to take on the globe's fastest and finest.

programme.desc: A young boy is taken to work by his Papa and Grandpa in an old wooden boat. He discovers his family's unusual line of work and will decide whether to follow them or find his way.

programme.title: Blue-Ribbon Bunny
programme.desc: Sofia and her bunny Clover enter a pet contest. Other kids have fancy pets. Sofia must decide: enter with a fancy pet or stay loyal to her best friend, Clover.

programme.title: Clover Time
programme.desc: When Clover's warren floods, Sofia invites her to move in. They love sharing a room-at first. But Sofia soon learns that being roommates isn't always easy in this fun story!

programme.title: Just One Of The Princes
programme.desc: Sofia wants to try out for a spot on Royal Prep's Flying Derby team, but Amber, Prince Hugo, and her classmates tell Sofia that Flying Derby is not a 'princess thing.'

programme.title: The Missing Necklace
programme.desc: When the Amulet of Avalor goes missing, Sofia loses her ability to understand her friends. Longing to talk to her friends again, Sofia sets off to find it. Cedric is also after the missing amulet.

programme.title: Welcome To Royal Prep
programme.desc: At Royal Prep's Open House, Amber's special painting gets ruined by James! Can Sofia help her fix it before her parents arrive? Find out in this exciting story!

programme.title: Me And Our Mom
programme.desc: Sofia is so excited to spend the day with her mom at the annual Mother's Day Picnic -until she learns that Amber and James are joining too. Sofia wants her mom to herself on Mother's Day!

programme.title: The Curse Of Princess Ivy
programme.desc: In this beautifully illustrated eBook, Sofia faces grave danger when she faces Princess Ivy, a once-exiled princess who is determined to take over Enchancia and turn the whole kingdom black and white.

programme.title: A Royal Mouse In The House
programme.desc: It's the Enchancia Pet Show! Hildegard's mink, Lulu, runs away, and Hildegard turns into a mouse! Sofia and Clover must solve the mystery and reverse the spell before the show begins.

programme.title: Princess Sofia'S Busy Day
programme.desc: Today is another busy day in the kingdom of Enchancia for Princess Sofia. Join Sofia and see what an ordinary day is like for this new princess!

programme.title: Royal Fun
programme.desc: Life in Enchancia is full of fun! Join Sofia as she explores all the fun things there are to do-from dancing to joining the flying derby team and even spending the day at the Village Faire.

programme.title: Sofia The First
programme.desc: Sofia was a little girl who lived a rather ordinary life. But everything changed when her mother married the king.

programme.title: The Amulet And The Anthem
programme.desc: Sofia is chosen to sing the Enchancian Anthem at the annual Harvest Festival. After she becomes a bit too boastful, Sofia's magical amulet bestows a curse on her, leaving her all croaked up!

programme.title: The Enchanted Science Fair
programme.desc: When Sofia and her friends discover that they need to find a magical ingredient at the top of a mountain, they compete to see who can reach the summit first! Can Sofia convince her fellow students.

programme.title: A Mother's Love
programme.desc: Follow Princess Merida and her mother Queen Elinor on an epic adventure set in the Highlands of Scotland. When a beastly curse is unleashed upon the kingdom, Merida must try and set things right.

programme.title: Big Bear, Little Bear
programme.desc: Enter the world of Brave and learn about opposites.

programme.title: Oh, Brother
programme.desc: Meet Merida, a fearless princess with three siblings who are in trouble. Read and listen to the story to learn what happens when they transform into bear cubs. Will Merida rescue them in time?

programme.title: Merida And The Missing Gem
programme.desc: Join the Disney reading. Merida chooses a beautiful brooch for her mother's birthday, but the pin goes missing, and she, with friends, has to search the castle grounds to find it.

programme.title: One Perfect Day
programme.desc: Despite being instructed to behave like a typical princess, Disney's Princess Merida desires to practice archery, explore the kingdom, and be herself for a day.

programme.title: Cinderella's Best Ever Creations
programme.desc: The story explores how Cinderella must work to create a collection of dresses in a time-crunch. She creates beautiful gowns for girls and solves problems by creating an extra dress in a time crunch.

programme.title: The Great Cat-tastrophe
programme.desc: Cinderella agrees to help Lady Dupont watch the cats, Cinderella finds a clever way for them to lend a hand on her chores. Follow along as Cinderella and the cats tidy up the house together.

programme.title: Kindness And Courage
programme.desc: Ella's stepfamily is jeaous of her beauty and grace and tries to stop her from going to the royal ball. Will Ella make it to the ball and get her happily ever after?

programme.title: Moana Finds The Way
programme.desc: Moana sets sail on a great adventure across the ocean. Follow along with the word for word narration.

programme.title: Beware Of The Kakamora
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! While on their important voyage, Moana and Maui encounter the dangerous Kakamora. Follow along with the word for word narration in this exciting adventure.

programme.title: Moana
programme.desc: Mater is tasked with capturing suspicious vehicles because he is a spy vehicle! See what a spy's life is like for Mater and his friends by following the narration word for word.

programme.title: Moana And The Ocean
programme.desc: An engaging story about Moana's unique relationship with the Ocean that playfully interacts with stylized artwork.

programme.title: Our Perfect Stormy Day
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! When a storm hits the island, Moana, Heihei, and Pua head to Gramma Tala's for story time. Follow along with word-for-word narration as they all enjoy the perfect stormy day!

programme.title: Where Monsters Live
programme.desc: Moana, daughter of chief Tui, embarks on a journey to return the heart of goddess Te Fitti from Maui, a demigod, after the plants and the fish on her island start dying due to a blight.

programme.desc: In Kumandra, Raya, a brave warrior, seeks the last dragon. She gathers a team to restore light and unity to their world. It's a fantasy adventure.

programme.title: Bella'S Big Break
programme.desc: Doc McStuffins helps Bella the ballerina doll overcome her fear after breaking her leg. With friends' support, Bella learns to dance again, proving courage and care can heal both body and spirit.

programme.title: Home Stinky Home
programme.desc: To save a cute little alien, Lilo and Stitch have to find him a new home. There's just one problem: the alien smells awful! Who will they find to take him in if he stinks up everyplace he goes?

programme.title: Maleficent
programme.desc: Maleficent, uninvited to Aurora's birth celebration, curses her. The curse can only be broken by a prince. Years later, Maleficent seeks Aurora.

programme.title: A Knight In Sticky Armor
programme.desc: Doc McStuffins doesn't just play with her toys-she heals them! Kids love this six-year-old doctor. Follow along with word-for-word narration as Doc McStuffins cures her brother's knight, Sir Kirby.

programme.title: A Sea Monster Story
programme.desc: Sea monsters Luca and Alberto have an amazing adventure on land. Will they be able to adjust to life on land?

programme.title: Toy Story
programme.desc: Of all the toys in Andy's room, Woody the cowboy is his favorite. But when Andy receives a brand-new toy for his birthday-a space ranger named Buzz Lightyear-Woody suddenly loses his number-one spot.

programme.title: Toy Story 2
programme.desc: Woody gets stolen by a toy collector; Buzz and friends embark on a daring mission to rescue him and his friends.

programme.title: Olaf'S Frozen Adventure
programme.desc: Arendelle celebrates its first holiday in years, but Anna and Elsa forgot their traditions. Olaf seeks the perfect new tradition in an exciting adventure.

programme.title: Frankenweenie
programme.desc: Victor Frankenstein uses lightning to revive his dog, Sparky, with some changes. He hides Sparky, but others learn his secret and want to revive their pets too.

programme.title: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Baloo and Bagheera thought Mowgli needed their protection at all times, but Mowgli thought differently. Why, he could fight like a bear and plan like a panther, too! Mowgli tries to save his new friend.

programme.title: Driven To Win
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen loves racing. But when a new racer arrives, will Lightning still be the fastest car on the track?

programme.title: Lead The Way
programme.desc: Follow along with word-for-word naration as Lightning McQueen discovers the wonders and importance of having a special somebody to help lead the way.

programme.title: Heavy Metal Mater
programme.desc: Mater and the Gas Caps, records a hit song, Mater becomes a rock legend. Then Lightning joins Mater's band for the rock concert of the century!

programme.title: Mater Private Eye
programme.desc: Detective Mater is hot on the trail of a dastardly car-napping! When Tiais sister goes missing, Mater is the only car she can turn to. With this tow truck on the case, anything can happen.

programme.title: Radiator Springs 500 1/2
programme.desc: Lightning and his companions concur that Stanley, the man who founded Radiator Springs. Lightning forced to defend Stanley's honour when Sandy interrupt the festivities and challenge him to a race.

programme.title: A Family Mystery
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Coco is the celebration of a lifetime. Follow along as the discovery of a generations-old mystery leads to a most extraordinary and surprising family reunion.

programme.title: Coco
programme.desc: Miguel dreams of becoming an accomplished musician like his idol, Ernesto de la Cruz. Desperate to prove his talent, Miguel finds himself in the stunning Land of the Dead following a chain of events.

programme.title: Miguel And The Amazing Alebrijes
programme.desc: Goldie and Bear have fun learning to fly with a lost broomstick. But when the owner is found, they must say goodbye. Read this adorable Disney storybook!

programme.title: Budderball'S First Fair
programme.desc: Budderball is most excited about the food at the town fair: cotton candy, popcorn, peanuts-it all sounds so delicious! When the hungry pup stumbles upon a pie-eating contest.

programme.title: Meet The Buddies
programme.desc: Meet the lovable Disney Buddies , perfect for audiences who already know the charismatic Buddies, or anyone who just loves dogs!

programme.title: The Halloween Visitor
programme.desc: The Buddies embark on a Halloween adventure. Trick-or-treating turns spooky when a black cat brings bad luck. They investigate the mysterious visitor and solve the Halloween puzzle!

programme.title: A Day with Papa
programme.desc: Explore Disney's read along as Papa Bunny guides Thumper on manners, teaching important lessons through fun adventures with word for word narration and delightful illustrations for children to enjoy.

programme.title: Thumper And The Egg
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! When Thumper finds an egg, he tries his hardest to keep it happy. Follow along with word-for-word narration as Thumper takes care of his new friend in this Level 1 reader.

programme.title: I Love You, My Bunnies
programme.desc: Thumper and his sisters want to give their mama the perfect gift for Mother's Day. So, they leave their playtime behind and go on an adventure in the forest.

programme.title: Thumper Counts to Ten
programme.desc: Thumper and his sisters laugh, play, and thump their way through a world filled with new discoveries, fun, and forest friends.

programme.title: Grandpa Bunny

programme.title: Meet Fawn The Animal-Talent Fairy
programme.desc: Fawn loves all the animals in Pixie Hollow. When Fawn makes an unusual furry friend, she must prove to the fairies that they can trust this warm hearted beast.

programme.title: New Friends
programme.desc: Tinker Bell meets a winter fairy named Periwinkle and together they explore the mysterious winter woods!

programme.title: Tink's Treasure Hunt

programme.desc: Tinker Bell and her fairy friends embark on an adventure to retrieve the stolen Blue Pixie Dust from pirates in this Disney Fairies storybook. Follow the narration!

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India’S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi’S & Bahu’S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What’S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga’S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga’S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga’S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children’s turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn’t happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we’ll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel’s Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery; both personal and culinary. Ranveer’s passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: TYOHAAR KI THAALI
programme.desc: Sakshi Tanwar in Tyohaar Ki Thaali decides to celebrate one festival a week and along with the celebration, she also prepares two dishes from her mom's diary which is her prized possession. Along with preparing the dishes she also reminisces into the moments of how she celebrated some festivals and also shares some stories about the Gods.

programme.title: SANRACHNA
programme.desc: Shelter - one of mankind’s most basic physiological needs. At least that’s what it started out as at the beginning of time. From dwelling in caves to carving out temples in mountains, mankind has redefined shelter with every passing era. Though the underlying philosophy of any monument is to serve some sort of function, great architecture is fuelled by imagination. India’s architecture is built on that very imagination and is a fascinating fusion of both art and science. From strategically placed astronomy towers to impressive and awe-inspiring tombs, Indian architecture has pushed the limits of engineering and design. Sanrachna explores these architectural wonders and how the makers of these marvels made them without the aid of modern mechanics and machinery. With an immensely astute sense of engineering, the architects were able to construct fortresses that have stood the test of time, unshaken by its changes. Join our host Vaibhavi as she travels through the country discovering the fascinating stories behind India’s outstanding monuments and its architecture. Sanrachna will leave you in awe of the past and its ability to do what we can’t, even with our modern tools and fancy tricks.

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel’s Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery; both personal and culinary. Ranveer’s passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANYA KAHANIYAAN
programme.desc: Raja Rasoi Aur Anya Kahaniyaan is a culinary history show that explores the food of the royals and their erstwhile states. The show takes it’s viewers through an amazing journey of anecdotes, folktales, architecture, art, history and landscape and delves into the unique customs and traditions of the various provinces. All these culminate into beautiful renditions of the recipes unique to those regions. This new season of Raja Rasoi aur Anya Kahaniyaan focuses on the royal families as protagonists and explores their personal stories and journeys that shaped their present day food practices.

The stories of Ramdin and Ramesh unravel back and forth and give us a compelling idea about how instilled the concept of feudalism is, in societies new and old.

programme.desc: SAANJH tells the story of Shyam and Sandhya, childhood friends who meet for the last time. Shyam loves Sandhya, but she sees him only as a friend. We surprisingly learn that Shyam is actually struggling with mental disorder, and Sandhya is nothing but just in his imagination. Despite the calm riverbank setting, Shyam's inner struggles are evident. As Shyam faces reality, he realizes he must accept things as they are, showing the power of love and understanding ourselves.

programme.title: Pilibhit
programme.desc: Inspired by true stories, Siraj, a righteous, impoverished flute maker, resides at the edge of the forests of Pilibhit, North India, where man-eating tigers thrive. His mounting livelihood pressures and tragedies corner him to take a drastic measure that threatens to tear down his values and a loved one.

programme.title: Shiva
programme.desc: A narrative following a young boy from the Potraj community, who confronts his stepfather, urging him to conform to tradition rather than pursue his aspiration of education and a brighter future. It underscores Shiva's resilience and support system as he strives to fulfill his dreams against all odds.

programme.title: Passbook
programme.desc: Set in the 90's when ATM and instant money transfer were still many years far away. In order to withdraw money people had to rely on a lengthy process of MT or Money Transfer which contained a bank to bank secret code.

programme.title: An Astrologer's Day
programme.desc: Based on a short story by R.K. Narayan from Malgudi Days. A normal day in the life of an astrologer reveals a lot about him.

programme.title: Anjaane
programme.desc: Shreya is a girl who suffers from clinical depression. After escaping a rape attempt, Shreya spirals further into depression and vows to end her life one night. Unknown to Shreya, her suicidal behavior is observed by her neighbor Aryan. The young man races against time to stop Shreya from committing suicide one night. During the night, Shreya and Aryan are drawn close to each other, and end up falling in love. Shreya's depression is finally lifted as she and Aryan embark on a new life together.

programme.title: Aflatoon
programme.desc: A narrative unfolding the tale of two brothers residing far from their home, eager to dispatch a sweet treat to their unwell father.

programme.title: Ansh
programme.desc: When Nidhi visits an orphanage with hopes of adopting, she is confronted by the unresolved trauma of losing her own child to kidnapping. As she battles grief and depression, she must find a way to heal and embrace life again. A poignant tale of loss, resilience, and the power of hope.

programme.title: Akhiri Parchi
programme.desc: This movie serves as an inspirational tool for kids, helping them grasp the extent of their parents' sacrifices and efforts to ensure their lives are comfortable and fulfilling, despite challenging circumstances. programme.title: Barat
programme.desc: A Typical miser starts picking up a mysterious trail of money only to find out something unearthly lurking around!

programme.desc: One year after the mysterious events of part 1, a newly married couple comes across a lady who claims to be Mangla. They are warned about the 150-year-old Witch that wanders around at night asking for an Onion. Things go haywire when a small girl knocks for help at midnight.

programme.title: Adhure Poore Se Hum
programme.desc: Two college time friends embark on a long drive on a Sunday morning, leaving their bustling city lives behind. As they amble through the hilly roads, they reveal to each other, their old longings and hidden pasts. Their rose tinted nostalgia is broken and they come face to face with their imperfect lives.

programme.title: Aam Ka Achaar
programme.desc: Haunted by the riots that took his parents 20 years ago, Karan confronts the man who once loved him as a son—yet betrayed him in the worst way. Torn between revenge and forgiveness, he seeks meaning in the madness. A powerful story of loss, betrayal, and the fight for redemption.

programme.title: Be Khush
programme.desc: Be Khush' is a satire and commentary on commercialism and the society we live in. In a dystopian world, where happiness is scarce and nobody is happy, comes 'Be Khush'. A pill which can provide you happiness on any occasion. But what happens, when someone starts giving away happiness for free?

programme.title: An Astrologer's Day
programme.desc: Based on a short story by R.K. Narayan from Malgudi Days. A normal day in the life of an astrologer reveals a lot about him.

programme.title: 10.30 Lets Go To School
programme.desc: Disha is an ordinary village girl with dreams like any other kid. Not only does she love her father unconditionally, but also her books and school. Life takes an unexpected turn when her Baba and Bua decide to discontinue their education. Her fate is about to meet that of thousands of other children who drop out of school every year. However, it is not so easy to give up. She is intelligent, confident and above all, determined to get back what she rightfully deserves, her right to dream!

programme.title: Ahsaas
programme.desc: Ahsaas is the emotional journey of Sana, a devoted wife caught in society’s definition of a “complete woman.” As childlessness becomes a burden, her husband’s support becomes her strength—leading them to seek help and reclaim their peace, together.

programme.title: Arundeep Singh
programme.desc: A man with a speech disorder who even struggles to do his day to day activities will face his greatest fear of dating a woman.

programme.title: Family
programme.desc: Anvith's friend Karthik is leaving school and moving to another city as his parents are getting divorced. This news makes Anvith very sad. The reason for their divorce which Karthik reveals to Anvith is a regular heated argument between Karthik's parents. Then Anvith also starts noticing the same argument between his parents. So, Anvith decides to do everything right so that their parents don't fight, but end up ruining everything which leads to a more heated argument.

programme.title: Bahar Aa Chaman Prakash
programme.desc: Bahar Aa Chaman Prakash" delves into the story of a man reluctant to marry his lifelong acquaintance. Shutting himself away and avoiding his father, he faces the girl his father wishes him to wed. When she joins him and locks themselves in a room, they emerge with a revelation connected to the man's inner struggles. Will his father embrace this truth?

programme.title: Alvida
programme.desc: Break-ups can be hard, but sometimes they are necessary. Sometimes, you need all your strength to let go and say ... Alvida.

programme.title: ABC
programme.desc: For some people life is about triumph against all odds, for some; life is only about complexities. Some walk through this road aimlessly and some; actually become the bridge. ABC is a short film that showcases the dichotomy between two extreme yet simple individuals. It is an empowering film which has the dexterity & optimism to resonate amongst all sections of audience. As humans, we do tend to forget that we are but one world than just mere economy, that it can just take one human, just one moment, just one action to turn around the paths of millions. ABC; is just a sweet gentle reminder of this thought.

programme.title: Agarbatti
programme.desc: Bhola, who is mentally challenged but still manages to survive by himself, selling incense sticks on the roads. An accident takes place near bhola, he doesn’t see the person clearly who is driving the car. Will he be able to tell the police about this incident?

programme.title: Live A Little
programme.desc: It starts with an after-party sequence. It is late at night. Nimisha, 26, struggles to get a ride back home when Atish, 46, sees this and offers her help. She refuses at first but eventually agrees. The journey gives Nimisha a peek into her boss's life. As they reach Nimisha’s destination they are ready to move on in their lives, but the night has more to offer them. Due to a sudden turn of events, they end up under one roof and despite their differences, they help each other get a new perspective

programme.title: A Tale Of An Onion Witch
programme.desc: Two flatmates, evidently from the gym-going North Indian breed of tinsel-town hopefuls, are warned about the 100 year old Witch that occasionally wanders around at night asking for an Onion. When an attractive neighbour knocks for help at midnight, their red-blooded fates unravel.

programme.title: Aplam Chaplam
programme.desc: Jayantika Sengupta: Rani Rahaao: Villain Zoya Sheikh: Child Sundeep Kumar: Son Vikar Tiwari: Friend of a son Sikandar Agarwal: Transgender

programme.desc: A struggling writer decides that he's going to make one last effort to pitch his idea to a film producer. He gets the chance to do so in an unusual way when he turns out to be driving a cab that the producer has hired.

programme.title: Ban Chor
programme.desc: A thief sneaks into a wealthy home for an easy heist—only to find the wife’s secret lover already there! But when the husband arrives, the thief and the lover must hide together, leading to a night of pure chaos, panic, and comedy. Because in this house… "Har chor pe ek mor hota hai!"

programme.title: Ae Ajnabi
programme.desc: Pappu, a misunderstood dreamer, carries a ring for the unknown—waiting for love, waiting for meaning. On a fateful night, he meets Chandini, a mysterious stranger who changes his world in just five hours. As they share stories, laughter, and heartbreak, Pappu finds answers he never knew he needed. But was she ever real? Or just a gift from the sun? A poetic journey of love, loss, and destiny.

programme.title: A Situation
programme.desc: A widower father, Pradeep has adapted to the challenging life of raising a daughter single-handedly after demise of his wife. One fine morning, she undergoes menstrual bleeding while taking a bath. Helpless and terrified she is locked inside the bathroom, not answering her father. He does not understand what to do next. This film shows that even today, periods stand as the biggest question to a lot of parents.

programme.title: Adarniya Mantri Ji
programme.desc: In a gripping tale, Finance Minister Supriya Chaudhry leads a crackdown on black money with her secretary, Laxman. After seizing 1200 crores, they discover 600 crores are missing. Laxman uncovers a secret plan, revealing himself as the masked figure holding the bank manager hostage. As chaos ensues and the truth unfolds, Laxman informs Supriya of their covert success, leaving viewers with a tense cliff hanger. The story ends with the title Adarniya Mantri Ji, leaving the mystery unresolved.

programme.title: Baalak
programme.desc: A film about a girl moving to Kolkata for her new job. She chooses a hotel for overnight stay where an incident makes her realize that life revolves in a circle and carries her emotionally very close to her home and family.

programme.title: Aakhri Sawari
programme.desc: Manish, a perfect husband and father, tormented by a mysterious parcel he receives from an anonymous sender has to make a life-changing decision. He shares his problems with his cab driver who listens patiently and tries to help. What the cab driver offers changes both of their lives forever.

programme.title: Avasthana
programme.desc: A Hindi short film revolving around the sad plight of a family who is struggling hard to cope up with everyday expenses. The situation gets so worst that the youngest son robs a chicken from a shop and gets it to the house in spite of them being vegetarians. programme.title: 23 B Raheja

The story revolves around a celebrated casting director whose charm masks a long trail of manipulation and exploitation. His power begins to crumble when a young woman arrives at his door, posing as an aspiring actress—but with a haunting connection to his past. As the night unfolds, so does a tense game of revelations, where truth becomes confrontation and justice takes an unexpected form. Taut, timely, and unsettlingly real, 23B Raheja is not just a story of reckoning—it’s a mirror held up to the systems we too often ignore.

programme.title: Universal Soldier: Day Of Reckoning
